Clandestine Crypto Mine Uncovered in Mexican Mountains Highlights Cartel Power Theft and Money Laundering

According to Reuters, Mexican law enforcement uncovered a clandestine cryptocurrency mining facility nestled in the mountainous Sierra Norte region of Puebla state (Tlaola municipality), suspected of being operated by organized crime to launder illicit capital. Authorities seized 300 graphics processing units (GPUs), 80 medium-voltage electrical terminals, and 8 satellite dishes, while investigating allegations that the facility siphoned industrial-scale electricity directly from a nearby hydroelectric dam infrastructure—marking the fourth such covert mining operation dismantled in the region since early last year.

Chainalysis specialists noted that major Latin American drug cartels are escalating their technical sophistication by establishing off-grid crypto mining nodes across territories under their territorial influence, exploiting zero-cost stolen power to mint virtual assets and launder criminal revenues off the radar of traditional banking oversight. — link

Thailand SEC Proposes Limits on Stablecoin Transfers to Third-Party Wallets, With ~$150K Daily One-Way Cap

Thailand’s SEC opened a consultation on new stablecoin rules that would require deposits and withdrawals through regulated digital asset operators to originate from and go to accounts or wallets verified as belonging to the same customer. Inbound and outbound transfers would each be capped at about $151,000 per person, per operator, per day. The cap would not apply to transfers between Thai-regulated operators that comply with the Travel Rule. The SEC said the proposal aims to reduce risks related to money laundering, cybercrime and circumvention of cross-border transfer rules. — link

A Bitcoin Seed Generator Is Using Radioactive Decay for Entropy

An open-source project called Entropy32 Plus uses radioactive decay as a physical entropy source to generate Bitcoin BIP39 seed phrases. A Geiger counter captures decay events, whose timing is processed through SHA-256 before being mapped to the BIP39 wordlist. The device is designed to operate fully offline with no wireless connectivity or persistent seed storage. The developer notes that its entropy quality has not yet been validated under NIST SP 800-90B and describes the project as experimental rather than independently audited for securing significant funds. — link
